```elixir title="Elixir"

result = LiterLlm.defaultclient_chat_async(client, "{\"messages\":[{\"content\":\"List items until you see STOP\",\"role\":\"user\"}],\"model\":\"gpt-4\",\"stop\":[\"STOP\",\"END\"]}")
```
